title: tc-message-actions
description:
The action bar under an AI chat message: copy, regenerate with a version switcher, thumbs with a feedback row, and
read aloud.

text.description: The message text – copied to the clipboard by Copy and used to time Read aloud

actions.description: Which actions to show, in this order

versions.description: All versions of the message, or just how many there are. From 2 on the version switcher shows

version.description: The shown version (0-based); unset, the bar keeps it, starting at `defaultVersion` and jumping to new versions

defaultVersion.description: Starting version while `version` is unset – defaults to the newest

regenerating.description: Keeps the regenerate arrow spinning while a new version is written

feedback.description: The vote: "up", "down" or null for none. Unset, the bar keeps it, starting at `defaultFeedback`

defaultFeedback.description: The vote to start with while `feedback` is unset

reasons.description: Quick reasons in the feedback row. "Other" opens a small text field

ownSpeech.description: Set when you play the audio yourself (listen to tc-speak): the bar then doesn't read `text` with the browser's speech synthesis. Without it (and without `speaking`) the browser reads `text`; where there is none, reading is simulated (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

speaking.description: Controlled playing state, e.g. tied to your speech player

speakDuration.description: How long an uncontrolled read aloud plays when it isn't the browser speaking, in ms – defaults to an estimate from `text`

demo.description: Demo mode: Read aloud is simulated silently where it would be simulated. For galleries and prototypes

quiet.description: Lighter icons until the message is hovered (default true; quiet="false" turns it off). Put data-ui-message on the message wrapper
